title.narrative: UNICEF strengthened government and partners’ capacity on Infant Young Child Feeding practice; prevention, early detection, and management of wasting; accelerating maternal nutrition; and community engagement for positive practices. Approximately 47 per cent of healthcare facilities across Pakistan are equipped to provide nutrition services with 12 per cent increase in 2024.
